title: Master Munda Source Census
description: Federated discovery census. Existing canonical source records remain in the master source register; newly discovered corpus-specific records remain in their evidence-preserving source bundles. This index measures the union without duplicating or renumbering permanent source IDs.

source_registers.counting_rule: Count only volume slots with a verified external locator or a registered corpus artifact that are not already represented in the canonical master source register.

metrics.note: Counts are repository-derived discovery/accounting metrics, not claims that all Munda sources have already been discovered. The 14 canonical records and the independently located Volume II record are distinct counted source records in the current federated census. Volume I's working transcription is not added to sources_discovered because its source identity is represented by the reserved Mundarica corpus structure rather than a separately verified bibliographic locator in MMSC at this stage.
